references.context: Every module element is uniquely a finite sum of homogeneous components drawn from the degree-indexed additive subgroups.
Degree-j additive subgroup of M, compatible with the S-action.
Products of scalar degree-n and module degree-j elements lie in module degree n+j.

references.phrase: ring indices nonnegative; module indices integer
references.disposition: The base graded ring may have only n≥0, while the graded module may have negative degrees.

review_rationale: Read a Z-graded module over a nonnegatively graded ring, with a direct sum decomposition and compatible degree addition under S_n multiplication, distinguishing grading of scalars and modules.
